name: Сафийя бинт Джухар
notes: Safiya bint Juhar, a caravan mistress out of the desert, caught on the plateau when Kragmir sealed itself. Her cargo has been standing outside a shut gate ever since, and she sells it off load by load to keep her seat at the Sixth Facet, the closed dice club of the Upper Vaults. She knows the roads on the far side of the plateau and she knows, by name, everyone else who is trapped under the mountain. She would pay anything for a way out, and at the table she bets like a woman with nothing left to protect.

actions.name: Every Hand Counts
actions.text:
Сафийя orders her caravan hands to fight without mercy. All allied creatures of equal or lower level within 20 feet of Сафийя gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls until the end of Сафийя's next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.Effect: No Quarter!]

actions.name: Karavan Bargain
actions.text:
Сафийя names a price to one creature within 30 feet that can hear and understand her, and attempts a @Check[type:diplomacy|against:will] check against its Will DC.

Critical Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Fascinated] by her and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Off-Guard] until the end of her next turn.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Fascinated] by her until the end of her next turn.

Failure No effect.

Critical Failure The target is immune to Karavan Bargain for 24 hours.

actions.name: Noble Pride
actions.text:
Trigger An opponent attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Demoralize] Сафийя or one of her allies within 30 feet

Effect Сафийя attempts to Demoralize the triggering opponent before the opponent rolls. On a critical success, the triggering action is disrupted as well.

actions.name: Bravery
actions.text: When Сафийя rolls a success on a Will save against a fear effect, she gets a critical success instead. In addition, any time she gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Frightened] condition, reduce its value by 1.

actions.name: Battle Scarred
actions.text: The first time each day Сафийя would be reduced to 0 HP, she remains at 1 HP and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Enfeebled]{Enfeebled 2} for the rest of the day.
